sentiment_evidence: Perfect, that's exactly my list. Thank you so much Riya.

issues.title: Wrong page after checkout
issues.problem_statement: After checkout, the customer's customers landed on the default thank-you page instead of the customer's own.

issues.title: Overlapping buttons on mobile
issues.problem_statement: On the customer's phone, the two buttons on their landing page overlapped each other.

issues.title: Emails going to spam
issues.problem_statement: The customer's emails were going to spam, and they had read that they needed to verify their email domain.

issues.title: Expired coupon
issues.problem_statement: The customer's coupon had expired and they were unsure whether to extend it.

issues.title: GST name on invoices
issues.problem_statement: The GST name on the customer's invoices showed their personal name instead of their company name.

issues.title: Weekly lesson unlocking
issues.problem_statement: The customer wanted the lessons of their course to unlock one per week for their students; the course is sold inside a bundle.

issues.title: AI quiz generator question
issues.problem_statement: The customer asked whether FlexiFunnels has an AI quiz generator.

issues.title: Exporting the student list
issues.problem_statement: The customer asked how to export their student list.

items.description: Customer pasted their thank-you page link into the empty redirect field in the product's After purchase settings and saved it, following support's guidance, and confirmed a test order now goes to their thank-you page.
evidence: Paste your thank-you page link there and save.
Pasted and saved. Let me do a test order... yes, it now goes to my thank-you page.

items.description: Customer increased the spacing between the two buttons in the mobile view of the page editor, following support's guidance, and confirmed on their phone that the buttons are now separate and look fine.
evidence: Select the button section and increase the spacing between the two buttons.
Okay I increased the spacing. Let me check on my phone... yes, now they are separate, it looks fine.

items.description: Support explained that to verify the email domain, the customer adds the domain in Email settings, receives three DNS records, adds those at their domain registrar, and then clicks Verify.
evidence: In Email settings, add your domain and you will get three DNS records.

items.description: Customer will get their developer, who holds the registrar login, to add the three DNS records at the domain registrar by Friday.
evidence: My developer has it. I'll get him to add the records by Friday.

items.description: Customer will click Verify in the email settings once the DNS records have been added.
evidence: Once the records are added, click Verify in the email settings.

items.description: Support explained that if the customer decides to extend the expired coupon, they can change the expiry date in the coupon settings; the decision is the customer's.
evidence: If you decide to extend it, you can change the expiry date in the coupon settings.

items.description: Customer reported that the GST name on their invoices shows their personal name, not their company name.
evidence: The GST name shows my personal name, not my company name.

items.description: Support will check with the billing team about changing the GST name on the invoices and get back to the customer within 2 working days.
evidence: I'll check with our billing team about changing it, and get back to you within 2 working days.

items.description: Support said there is a drip schedule setting for lessons, but that support is not sure whether it works when the course is sold inside a bundle.
evidence: There is a drip schedule setting for lessons.
I'm not sure whether it works when the course is sold inside a bundle

items.description: Support will check with the product team whether the drip schedule works for a course sold in a bundle and get back to the customer.
evidence: Let me check that with our product team and get back to you.

items.description: Support said it is not aware of a quiz generator being available right now, has no date for one, and asked the customer not to plan around it.
evidence: I'm not aware of a quiz generator being available right now, and I don't have a date for one.
So please don't plan around it.

items.description: Customer will try exporting their student list later, using the steps support gave: go to Students, click Export and choose CSV, which downloads a file that opens in a spreadsheet.
evidence: Go to Students, click Export, and choose CSV.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
